news.title: New Chattanooga Thrift Trail Website Is “Labor Of Love”
news.text: The Chattanoogan has featured the Thrift Trail: a new website that maps more than 50 thrift shops, vintage shops and antique malls across Chattanooga and nearby North Georgia. Enter your location, pick a route, and get a driving plan built around shop hours, with no app or account needed. Thank you to The Chattanoogan for sharing the Trail with the community.

news.title: The Thrift Trail Is Now On Instagram
news.text: Follow @chattanoogathrifttrail for new shops, sales and finds from all around the Trail.

news.title: Trail News Has Opened
news.text: Shop sales, new small businesses, events and every time the Thrift Trail makes the news will land here. Have news from your shop? Send it to the moderators.
